== NAME ==
hwStrip - create a triangular strip of vertices

== INHERITS FROM ==
* [[hwSurface]]
* [[hwOrient]]
* [[hwVertex]]

== PROPERTIES ==
| Data | *F | The data array, with 3 to 11 floats per vertex
| OptFlags | 1I | Optimization flags; see [[hw]] for more details

== DEFAULTS ==
| Data | NULL
| OptFlags | hwDefaultOptFlags

== DESCRIPTION ==
The hwStrip class takes an array of vertices and displays them as a
triangular strip.  The Data pointer is an array of hwFloat values;
the number of values must be equal to n*FPV, where FPV is the number
of hwFloats present per vertex as described by the hwVertex man
page, and n is an arbitrary integer.

== C EXAMPLE ==
{{{
    /* Draw a two-sided square using the hwStrip primitive */
    hwObject
        strip;
    hwFloat
        data[] = {
            0,0,0,      1,0,0,
            0,1,0,      1,1,0
        };

    strip = hwStrip->create( hwStrip );
    strip->modify( strip, hwStrData, HW_MAKE_TYPE(HW_TYPE_FLOAT,3*4), data );
    HW_MODIFY_1B( strip, hwStrTwoSided, HW_TRUE );
    strip->draw( strip );
    strip->destroy( strip );
}}}

== OBJECT FILE EXAMPLE ==
{{{
    # A two-sided square using an hwStrip
    hwStrip strip {
        TwoSided = True
        Data = {0,0,0,  1,0,0,    0,1,0,  1,1,0}
    }
}}}
